name: io.github.googlarz/proton-mail-bridge-client
description: CLI and Claude Desktop MCP server for Proton Mail via Proton Bridge. Can be set to read-only or drafts-only, to require your approval before anything is sent or deleted, and keeps a tamper-evident audit log. The default mode is full (sending allowed). The server and index run locally over Bridge's IMAP/SMTP; text the AI model reads goes to the model provider unless the model is local.

environmentVariables.name: PROTONMAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Proton Bridge password (Bridge app -> account -> Mailbox details) — not your Proton account password
